rawContent: I was hoping that this would eclipse me. Somehow, I hoped, I wouldn't know any of the accused offenders. Then my mind wandered and I recognized patterns of behavior that I couldn't see at the time, or ignored because I wanted to be a part of a team #MeToo https://t.co/1hqlbZQ8Ww

I just had a conversation with someone else I've skated with who was assaulted. She said something just now that I need to share:

"We are at an important time to change things and this is my tiny way to help."

#MeToo
